notes.en: Shows what the recorded answers force and names the questions that forced it. This is NOT the official RoB 2 flowchart; the domain and overall judgements are yours. If you depart from the implied judgement, give a reason (logged as a decision, X017). The official algorithm branches on 2.6/2.7, 3.3/3.4 and 4.3–4.5; check borderline domains against the official Excel tool or the 2019 guidance flowcharts.
